sources.entry: motionEye - Online interface for the software Motion, a video surveillance program with motion detection. GPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: motionEye is a web-based interface for the Motion video surveillance program, providing motion detection and camera management through a browser.
summary.what_it_does: motionEye is an online interface for the software Motion, a video surveillance program with motion detection. The README describes installation via pip on APT- or RPM-based Linux distributions with systemd, using a helper command (motioneye_init) to set up services. The web interface listens on port 8765 and ships with a default admin user with an empty password, which the README says should be changed. The project is multilingual from version 0.43 and accepts translation contributions through Weblate. Upgrade and pre-release installs are covered with pip, including the --pre flag and installing a development branch commit. The README does not describe specific camera features in detail; it points to the wiki for those.
use_cases: home video surveillance with motion detection
monitoring IP cameras through a web browser
setting up a self-hosted security camera system
remotely checking camera feeds over the internet
managing Motion software through a web UI
how_to_run: sudo apt --no-install-recommends install ca-certificates curl python3
Open http://[your_ip]:8765 in a browser and log in as admin with an empty password, then set a password
notable: Web interface for the Motion motion-detection program
Installs from PyPI with pre-compiled wheels on most systems
Multilingual interface with Weblate translation support
Includes a motioneye_init setup command for systemd-based systems
Supports installing pre-releases or a development-branch commit via pip
caveats: motioneye_init assumes an APT- or RPM-based distribution with systemd; manual setup needed otherwise
On ARMv6/ARMv7, RISC-V and rare architectures, extra build dependencies may be needed
Default admin account has an empty password until changed
